name: Folder Dock
description:
A sleek, responsive dock for GNOME Shell featuring mobile-style app folders, smart autohide, and smooth workspace integration.

Key Highlights:
• Mobile-Style App Folders: Bundle multiple applications directly on your dock with live 2×2 mini-icon previews.
• Intuitive Drag-and-Drop: Drop one app onto another to instantly create a folder, or drag apps into existing folders.
• Seamless Folder Management: Click to open a smooth popup grid; right-click for quick renaming, unbundling, or unpinning.
• Intelligent Autohide (Intellihide): Keeps your screen clear by tucking the dock away whenever windows overlap it, with instant bottom-edge pressure reveal.
• Window & Running Indicators: Multi-dot indicators show open windows at a glance, with middle-click new window launching and single-click window cycling.
• Native GNOME Sync: Keeps your pinned favorites two-way synced with GNOME's native favorite-apps.
• Fully Customizable: Personalize icon sizing, dock margins, background opacity, autohide behavior, and app grid button placement.
